wording.b_instruction: Based on the note above, give the answer as a short phrase. Do not reply unknown.
wording.cut: ablate_evidence + N-cut note (split_note of generated, byte-exact; no marker -> no note) + Answer:
wording.position: ':' of Answer:, prefix cache excludes it
wording.residual: decoder layer output, pre final norm
wording.classifier: v2: refusal = §23 rule on the phrase; degenerate = empty / no alnum / a run of >= 8 identical ids

forcing: unpushed prefix cache through the token before ':'; ':' unpushed (argmax recorded, unused); forced id = gen_ids[0]; greedy, no hook at any step; EOS / newline stop (newline token kept); max new tokens counts the forced one
tokenisation: first id of ids(continuation + text) after the ids(continuation) prefix (prefix asserted stable)
